insights.headline: Fed hike bets and oil keep gold pinned near $4,120
insights.summary: December Fed hike expectations and energy-driven inflation fears are pinning gold below $4,200 while silver hovers near $57.50. In India, the September price correction has buyers weighing wedding-season purchases, even as NBFC gold loans surge to record levels with early signs of borrower stress.
points: Analysts split on gold: $4,000–$4,135 is the make-or-break zone with December hike bets near 90%.
24K gold at ₹1,46,270/10g is 5% below September; analysts suggest staggered wedding-season buying.
MCX gold near ₹1,46,130 and silver ₹2,09,752 track global weakness on oil-driven inflation fears.
India's NBFC gold-loan book nearly doubled to ~₹1 lakh crore; some lenders flag rising borrower stress.

trending.title: Fed hike bets vs gold: the $4,000–$4,135 line
trending.summary: December hike expectations and firm oil pin gold below $4,200. Two analysts see more downside toward $4,000, one calls it an asymmetric buy; the weekly close near $4,100 is decisive.

trending.title: India's gold-credit boom flashes early warnings
trending.summary: NBFC gold loans nearly doubled to ~₹1 lakh crore in a year, now ~10% of four big lenders' books, but 15–23% of recent disbursements went to already-delinquent borrowers, per Piramal.

trending.title: Wedding-season dip buying in India
trending.summary: Gold's 5% September correction has buyers weighing jewellery purchases; retailers push lighter designs and old-gold exchanges while ETFs draw record inflows.

trending.title: Silver under pressure near $57.40
trending.summary: Oil-driven inflation fears and hike bets weighed on silver near $57.40; India's Hindustan Zinc still leans on the metal for earnings growth despite broker caution.

items.title: These 3 analysts' Gold forecasts: Two see more pain ahead, one calls it an asymmetric trade
items.summary: Two of three FXStreet analysts see further downside for gold after a fourth straight losing session near $4,115. Sagar Dua points to 10-year Treasury yields near 5.13% and oil near $99, with $4,000 the key support; Radomska watches the $4,098–$4,135 weekly gap for a decisive bearish turn. Maharrey dissents, calling the dip an asymmetric trade backed by sustained central-bank buying.

items.title: Gold loans lead NBFC growth; portfolio share touches double digits
items.summary: Gold loans are the fastest-growing NBFC segment: the combined gold book of Bajaj Finance, HDB Financial, L&T Finance and IIFL nearly doubled YoY to almost ₹1 lakh crore last quarter, about 10% of their combined books. IIFL's gold book hit ₹65,729 crore, 53% of its AUM. Piramal flagged 15–23% of recent industry disbursements going to already-delinquent borrowers.

items.title: Wedding Season 2026: Gold prices crashed over 5% in a month — Should you buy jewellery now or wait? Experts suggest
items.summary: 24K gold stood at ₹1,46,270 per 10 grams on October 21, down 5.13% from ₹1,53,780 on September 21. Analysts at Anand Rathi, Motilal Oswal and Trackk describe the correction as a buying window for wedding-season purchases, noting demand typically strengthens through October–November, and suggest staggered buying as festive demand supports prices.

items.title: MCX Gold Drops to ₹146,130 as Crude Oil Price Rise Fuels Inflation
items.summary: December gold futures on MCX fell to ₹1,46,130 per 10 grams and silver to ₹2,09,752 per kg as higher crude stoked inflation fears and kept rate expectations elevated. Gold's next supports are pegged at ₹1,45,750 and ₹1,44,980; silver has support near ₹2,08,570 with resistance at ₹2,13,920. COMEX gold hovered near $4,139 with silver around $57.57.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD declines to near $57.40 as oil price remains broadly firm
items.summary: Silver slipped about 1.1% to near $57.40 in European trade as firm oil prices fed global inflation fears. Danske Bank analysts cited mounting Middle East supply concerns, with WTI near $98.25 after touching a five-week high of $101.05. Elevated inflation expectations could keep Fed hike bets alive, pressuring non-yielding silver; CME FedWatch still expects the Fed to hold at this month's meeting.

items.title: Gold (XAUUSD) & Silver Price Forecast: December Hike Bets Build, Can Gold Hold $4,119?
items.summary: An FXEmpire analyst sees rising December Fed hike expectations keeping both metals under pressure, with gold defending the $4,119 triangle support and silver near $57.43 testing trendline resistance. The analyst is neutral to slightly bearish until a move above $4,176 or a break below $4,119 confirms the next direction.

items.title: Hindustan Zinc's Q2 earnings glow on lower costs, higher metal prices
items.summary: Hindustan Zinc's Q2FY27 revenue rose 77% to ₹15,100 crore and EBITDA 108% on higher metal prices, lower costs and stronger volumes. LBMA silver averaged $62.6/oz in the quarter, up nearly 60% YoY, with sales volumes up 24%. Brokerages stay divided: Jefferies cut its target to ₹650 on silver volatility, while Citi flagged limited upside from current zinc and silver prices.

items.title: US Dollar Is Falling - So Why Isn't Gold Rallying?
items.summary: Gold has failed to rally even as the dollar eased, with energy-driven inflation fears and firm December Fed hike expectations capping bullion near $4,120. The analysis points to next week's October 27–28 Fed meeting and incoming inflation data as the next directional catalyst.

items.title: Gold Demand Picks Up as India's Festive and Wedding Season Begins
items.summary: World Gold Council's Oct 20 India update shows manufacturers seeing strong orders as retailers stock up for the festive and wedding season, with foot traffic improving. Old-gold exchanges jumped over 10% YoY, over half of sales at some stores. Gold ETFs drew ₹4,450 crore of net inflows in September, a seven-month high, though bar and coin demand cooled and imports hit their lowest since March.

items.title: Oil Plunges on Deal Hopes: The Market Is Already Pricing in an Iran Breakthrough
items.summary: Crude prices pulled back as the market priced in a potential Iran breakthrough, easing the energy-driven inflation fears that have been pressuring gold. With oil's rebound the key force behind this week's Fed hike bets, any sustained de-escalation could change the calculus for bullion.
